info.title: SuperPipeline board reads
info.description: What a service reads of a board: the board list, the board snapshot, one card and its attempts, comments, links and activities, and a run's evidence. Written from SuperPipeline's apps/api/src/service-routes.ts (the reads, `cards:read`), apps/api/src/routes/boards/evidence.ts (the evidence, `evidence:read`), board/pipeline.ts (the snapshot), board/run-history.ts, board/comments.ts, card-links.ts and db/catalog.ts. A person and a coordinator agent read the same paths and get the same bodies; this document contracts the service form, whose tenant comes from the token, so a board in another tenant is 404 BOARD_NOT_FOUND. Every refusal is error.v1. Bodies are open, a reader ignores properties it does not know, except the run evidence, which is closed: its C4 shape is frozen and its v1 shape is read strictly.

get.summary: Every board in the token's tenant

get.description: The read a placement service starts every pass with (its stages and cards), and the one a library reads a board's cards and references from. A board that is not this tenant's, or is not initialised, is BOARD_NOT_FOUND.
A card the board does not have answers an empty list, not a refusal.

200.description: Every comment, oldest first, deleted ones included with an empty body and `deletedAt` set
The card's edges, from both stores

get.description: A card with no edges, or one the board does not have, answers two empty lists.

get.summary: A card's timeline, handoff and gates
get.description: A card the board does not have answers empty lists and a null handoff.

200.description: The run, its card, the gates that judged it and its usage

get.description: Answered before any other board route: only a service token with `evidence:read` reads it, and it reads nothing else. Agents and people may not. The principal ids are filled from the catalogue.

200.description: The C4 evidence under `pipeline`, with provenance, usage and the executor's evidence path

get.description: An explicit opt-in beside `…/evidence`, on the same credential and refusals. A reader that finds another `schema_version` refuses it rather than reading it as v1.

serviceToken.description: An Organization-plane access token for a service principal (`principalKind: service`) of a workspace mapped to a SuperPipeline tenant: `cards:read` for the board and card reads, `evidence:read` for a run's evidence. No valid service token is 401 UNAUTHORIZED; a scope it lacks is 403 FORBIDDEN.

boardId.name: boardId
boardId.description: The board. The service routes match only brd_ and 16 lowercase hex digits.

cardId.name: cardId
cardId.description: The card. The service routes match only card_ and 16 lowercase hex digits.

evidenceBoardId.name: boardId
evidenceBoardId.description: The board the run is on. Any path segment: a board that is not this tenant's, or not initialised, is BOARD_NOT_FOUND.

Unauthorized.description: No valid service token for a mapped workspace (UNAUTHORIZED)

NotFound.description: No such board in this tenant (BOARD_NOT_FOUND), card (CARD_NOT_FOUND, NOT_INITIALIZED) or run (RUN_NOT_FOUND)

ActivityView.description: One durable entry in a card's timeline (ActivityView, board/views.ts). Ephemeral activities are not kept.

ApprovalSubjectEnvelope.description: A subject as a decision envelope carries it (gate.v2 §3): identity, expiry and the bounded preview.

ApprovalSubjectView.description: A frozen approval subject with its canonical payload (ApprovalSubjectView).

canonical.description: Any JSON value: the kind's canonical payload.

BoardSnapshot.description: The whole board as one read (BoardSnapshot, board/views.ts; built by snapshot in board/pipeline.ts): its stages, every card, the pending gates and questions, every reference, usage, and its settings. A board that is not initialised is 404 BOARD_NOT_FOUND, so `boardId` is always a string here. `intro` and `decisionTimeout` are present only when set.

stages.description: In board order. A placement service reads each stage's `key`, `ownerKind`, `owner`, `requires` and `placement`.

cards.description: Every card, archived ones included (`archivedAt` set).

gates.description: The pending gates on cards that are not archived, oldest first, each with its `summary`.

elicitations.description: The questions agents are blocked on.

references.description: Every reference on every card; a reader filters by `cardId`.

triggerGrantCount.description: How many principals the board's trigger grant names, never which; null when none is recorded.

BoardSummary.description: One board in the token's tenant (listBoards, db/catalog.ts).

CardActivities.description: A card's history (getCardActivities, board/run-history.ts): its timeline oldest first, its current handoff, and every gate on it, decided ones included, with who decided and what they said.

CardLinks.description: Every edge touching a card (cardLinksBody, card-links.ts): same-board `links` from the board, cross-board `externalLinks` from the catalogue. `enforced` is true only for an edge that can refuse a claim (`blocks`, `parent`); a cross-board edge is advisory, always false.

otherBoardName.description: Null when the other board is not this tenant's, or is gone.

otherCardTitle.description: Null when the other card cannot be read, for any reason.

CardReservation.description: The live hold on a card (CardReservation, packages/contract claims.ts): the agent it is held for, until when, the placement decision that asked for it and the service that made it. A lapsed hold is never shown.

CardView.description: A card as every board route returns it (CardView, board/model.ts).

spec.description: Any JSON value: the card's spec.

repositories.description: Proposed. The repositories this card chose from a stage allowlist (run-checkpoint-policy.v2), sorted. Absent: the card names none. Fixed once the card's bench exists.

primaryRepository.description: Proposed. One of `repositories`: where the card's work starts. Only with `repositories`.

CommentView.description: A remark on a card (CommentView, board/views.ts).

Delivery.description: How an approved publishing subject is delivered (GateView.delivery).

ElicitationView.description: An agent's question to a person, with its answer once given (ElicitationView, board/views.ts).

ExecutionExportHint.description: Where AgentPod's execution export for this reference is, as the agent attached it. Producer metadata only: it confers no authority and is not verified here.

GateOption.description: An option as the board stores it (GateOption, board/gate-option.ts). The pushed and pending bodies rename `name`/`title` to `id`/`label`; this is the board's own read shape.

GateView.description: One gate, including how it was decided (GateView, board/views.ts). `status` includes `cancelled`, which the board writes when a card is moved or archived with a review pending, though the producer's type leaves it out.

decision.description: The decision recorded, or null while pending or once cancelled. A gate closed because its subject expired carries the board's expired marker.

summary.description: What is being approved, as plain text; absent when the gate binds a subject.

JsonValue.description: Any JSON value, stored and returned as given.

LinkKind.description: An edge's kind. Open: a reader treats a kind it does not know as decoration. The kinds on 2026-11-24 are in x-treaty-known-values; only `blocks` and `relates` cross boards.

agent_principal_id.description: `prn_…`, or null when the agent is not linked to a principal.

stage_key.description: The card's current stage, which may be past the run's.

gates.description: The gates this run opened, and legacy gates on the card matched by stage, oldest first.

usage.description: `reported` with summed numbers, or `unreported` with nulls: a run with no usage record cost something unknown, never zero.

RunEvidence.description: One run as evidence (RunEvidence, board/views.ts; contract C4), snake_case. Closed: this shape is frozen, and what is new goes in superpipeline-run-evidence/v1.

run_id.description: Null on a legacy gate, matched to the run by its stage or return stage.

decision.description: In past tense; null while pending, once cancelled, or for a decision evidence does not name.

produced_by_principal_id.description: `prn_…`, or null when the producer is not linked to a principal.

decided_by_principal_id.description: `prn_…`, or null when the decider is not linked to a principal.

decided_by_hub_sub.description: The token subject the decider is known by, set only when `decided_by_principal_id` is null: one way to name the judge, never two.

RunEvidenceGate.description: A gate as evidence (RunEvidenceGate, board/views.ts): decisions in past tense, the run it judged, nothing else.

references_truncated.description: True when the run attached more than the 256 references carried.

references.description: The references this run attached, oldest first.

provenance.description: Producer metadata about the run (RunEvidenceProvenanceV1). It does not confer authority or independent verification.

usage.description: What the run cost, and how much of that is known (RunUsageEvidenceV1). A recorded cost is what the agent reported, not a provider's bill.

agentpod_path.description: The AgentPod evidence path for this run. Discovery only: a reader authenticates to AgentPod and checks the binding itself.

RunEvidenceV1.description: The versioned run evidence (RunEvidenceV1, board/views.ts; packages/contract run-evidence.ts): the C4 shape nested unchanged under `pipeline`, with provenance, usage and where the executor's evidence is. Closed at every level.

cardCheckpointPolicy.description: Proposed. The checkpoint policy of a stage whose cards choose their repositories from its allowlist. Never together with `checkpointPolicy`. Offered only to a claimant whose `checkpointProtocols` lists superpipeline.checkpoint-claim.v2.

TaskState.description: The A2A task states; `canceled` with one l, as A2A spells it.
